MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

Section 1. Definitions
1.1 "Services" means the services described in Schedule A.
1.2 "Security Incident" has the meaning given in Section 7.2.

Section 2. Payment
2.1 Fees. Fees are payable in accordance with the invoicing terms set forth in Section 3.2(b).
2.2 Taxes. Customer shall pay applicable taxes as described in Section 4.3.

Section 3. Invoicing
3.1 Invoices. Provider will issue monthly invoices.
3.2 Payment Mechanics.
(a) Timing. Payment is due within thirty (30) days.
(b) Late Payment. Any unpaid amount may trigger the remedies in Section 5.1.

Section 4. Compliance
4.1 Compliance Program. Each party shall maintain a compliance program.
4.2 Audit Cooperation. Audit procedures are described in Appendix I.
4.3 Tax Records. The parties shall retain tax records consistent with Schedule B.

Section 5. Remedies
5.1 Suspension. Provider may suspend Services under the conditions in Section 2.1.
5.2 Termination. Termination rights are subject to Section 9.4.

Section 6. Confidentiality
6.1 Use Restrictions. Confidential Information may only be used for contract performance.
6.2 Survival. Obligations survive as stated in Section 9.2.

Section 7. Security
7.1 Controls. Provider shall implement reasonable safeguards.
7.2 Incident Notice. Notice content must include the items listed in Appendix II.

Section 8. Miscellaneous
8.1 Assignment. Neither party may assign this Agreement without consent.
8.2 Notices. Formal notices must be sent to the addresses in Schedule C.
For convenience, this section summarizes operational sections used across the Agreement.

Section 9. General
9.1 Entire Agreement. This Agreement includes the schedules and appendices.
9.2 Survival List. Sections 6.1 and 6.2 survive expiration.
9.3 Interpretation. References to section headers are for convenience only.
9.4 Order of Precedence. In case of conflict, Appendix I prevails over Schedule A.

Appendix I. Audit Procedures
The audit scope is described here.

Appendix II. Incident Notice Items
The required notice fields are described here.

Detailed services description.

Schedule B. Record Retention Matrix
